q: The environmental problems directly related to energy production and consumption include air pollution, climate change, water pollution, thermal pollution, and solid waste _____.
e: The environmental problems directly related to energy production and consumption include air pollution, climate change, water pollution, thermal pollution, and solid waste disposal. management or recycling is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: Global warming refers to the gradual increase in the average temperature of the earth's surface and its atmosphere which has been attributed to the accumulation of _____ gases.
e: Global warming refers to the gradual increase in the average temperature of the earth's surface and its atmosphere which has been attributed to the accumulation of greenhouse gases. toxic or noble is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: The main greenhouse gases are carbon dioxide ($CO_2$), methane ($CH_4$), water vapour, oxides of nitrogen ($NO_x$) and _____.
e: The main greenhouse gases are carbon dioxide (CO₂), methane (CH₄), water vapour, oxides of nitrogen (NO_x) and chlorofluorocarbons. Methane is a swamp gas and a digestive by-product; it is also the main component of natural gas. sulfur dioxide or carbon monoxide is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: CFCs also destroy the earth's protective _____ layer which shields the earth from harmful ultraviolet (UV) rays from the sun.
e: CFCs also destroy the earth's protective ozone layer which shields the earth from harmful ultraviolet (UV) rays from the sun. atmospheric or ionosphere is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: Acid rains are caused mainly by the release of sulphur dioxide ($SO_2$) and oxides of nitrogen ($NO_x$) when _____ burn.
e: Acid rains are caused mainly by the release of sulphur dioxide (SO₂) and oxides of nitrogen (NO_x) when fossil fuels burn. Coal, oil and natural gas are fossil fuels: non-renewable stores that form far slower than we burn them. biomass or wood is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: The oil industry adds lead (Pb) to petrol (gasoline) to help engines run more _____.
e: The oil industry adds lead (Pb) to petrol (gasoline) to help engines run more smoothly. efficiently or cleanly is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: The World Health Organisation (WHO) has established that smoke from the combustion of leaded fuels in vehicles causes cancer and high blood pressure in adults; and in children, it impairs mental development, reduces intelligence thus hindering learning ability and causes _____ disorders.
e: The choice that completes this fact is behavioural. physical or respiratory is a different idea, so those options are wrong. That matches the specific detail about World Health Organisation established smoke combustion.

q: Excavated areas that have been strip mined for coal but are not filled and revegetated cause water pollution as surface water runoff from the mined area can flush sediments and _____-bearing compounds into nearby streams and rivers.
e: The choice that completes this fact is sulphur. Coal, oil and natural gas are fossil fuels: non-renewable stores that form far slower than we burn them. carbon or nitrogen is a different idea, so those options are wrong. That matches the specific detail about Excavated areas been strip mined coal.

q: A solar module will prevent the emission of $CO_2$ produced by other conventional energy sources. Photovoltaic systems make no noise and cause no pollution while in _____.
e: A solar module will prevent the emission of CO₂ produced by other conventional energy sources. Photovoltaic systems make no noise and cause no pollution while in operation. The photovoltaic effect turns light into electrical energy inside a semiconductor junction. manufacturing or disposal is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: A wind farm, when installed on agricultural land, has one of the lowest environmental impacts of all energy sources. It occupies less land area per kilowatt hour (kWh) of electricity generated than any other energy _____ system.
e: The choice that completes this fact is conversion. transmission or distribution is a different idea, so those options are wrong. That matches the specific detail about wind farm installed agricultural land lowest.

q: Modern turbine designs which locate the blades upwind instead of downwind have significantly reduced the level of _____.
e: Modern turbine designs which locate the blades upwind instead of downwind have significantly reduced the level of infrasound. ultrasound or resonance is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: Wind turbines may create shadow _____ on nearby residences when the sun passes behind the turbine.
e: Wind turbines may create shadow flicker on nearby residences when the sun passes behind the turbine. glare or reflection is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: Although hydropower has no air quality impacts, construction and operation of hydropower dams can significantly affect natural river systems as well as fish and _____ populations.
e: Although hydropower has no air quality impacts, construction and operation of hydropower dams can significantly affect natural river systems as well as fish and wildlife populations. livestock or human is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: Large amounts of plant life are submerged and decay _____ in large dams.
e: Large amounts of plant life are submerged and decay anaerobically in large dams. aerobically or chemically is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: Dams serve as a heat sink, water in dams is hotter than the normal river water and when this warm water released into the river downstream can affect _____ life.
e: Dams serve as a heat sink, water in dams is hotter than the normal river water and when this warm water released into the river downstream can affect animal life. plant or microbial is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: Electricity generation from geothermal resources involves much lower _____ gas emission rates than that from fossil fuels.
e: Electricity generation from geothermal resources involves much lower greenhouse gas emission rates than that from fossil fuels. Geothermal energy is heat from the Earth's interior, used to drive turbines. toxic or noble is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: Biomass power plants, like coal and natural gas-fired power plants, require water for _____.
e: Biomass power plants, like coal and natural gas-fired power plants, require water for cooling. Biomass is renewable organic material from plants and animals. heating or cleaning is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: Land use impacts from biomass power production are driven primarily by the type of _____: either a waste stream or an energy crop that is grown specifically for generating electricity.
e: Land use impacts from biomass power production are driven primarily by the type of feedstock: either a waste stream or an energy crop that is grown specifically for generating electricity. Biomass is renewable organic material from plants and animals. fertilizer or pesticide is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: In the energy transfers which occur in each type of energy resource, Fossil fuels follow the sequence: chemical energy $\rightarrow$ thermal energy $\rightarrow$ kinetic energy $\rightarrow$ _____ energy.
e: In the energy transfers which occur in each type of energy resource, Fossil fuels follow the sequence: chemical energy → thermal energy → kinetic energy → electrical energy. Coal, oil and natural gas are fossil fuels: non-renewable stores that form far slower than we burn them. mechanical or potential is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: Solar energy transfer sequence is: light & thermal energy $\rightarrow$ _____ energy.
e: Solar energy transfer sequence is: light & thermal energy → electrical energy. Solar energy is the Sun's radiant light and heat. Irradiance is that radiation per unit area per unit time. kinetic or chemical is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: Nuclear energy transfer sequence is: nuclear energy $\rightarrow$ thermal energy $\rightarrow$ kinetic energy $\rightarrow$ _____ energy.
e: Nuclear energy transfer sequence is: nuclear energy → thermal energy → kinetic energy → electrical energy. Nuclear fission consumes uranium fuel, so that source is classed as non-renewable. mechanical or light is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: Wind energy transfer sequence is: _____ energy $\rightarrow$ electrical energy.
e: Wind energy transfer sequence is: kinetic energy → electrical energy. Wind power incident on area A is P = ½ρAv³, so it grows with the cube of wind speed. potential or thermal is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: Hydroelectricity energy transfer sequence is: gravitational potential energy $\rightarrow$ _____ energy $\rightarrow$ electrical energy.
e: Hydroelectricity energy transfer sequence is: gravitational potential energy → kinetic energy → electrical energy. Hydroelectric plants turn gravitational potential energy of water into kinetic energy and then electrical energy. thermal or chemical is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: Geothermal energy transfer sequence is: thermal energy $\rightarrow$ _____ energy $\rightarrow$ electrical energy.
e: Geothermal energy transfer sequence is: thermal energy → kinetic energy → electrical energy. Geothermal energy is heat from the Earth's interior, used to drive turbines. potential or chemical is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: Tidal energy transfer sequence is: _____ energy $\rightarrow$ electrical energy.
e: Tidal energy transfer sequence is: kinetic energy → electrical energy. potential or thermal is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: Acid rain is caused by a chemical reaction that begins when compounds like sulfur dioxide and nitrogen oxides are released into the air, where they mix and react with water, oxygen, and other chemicals to form more acidic pollutants, known as _____.
e: The choice that completes this fact is acid rain. Acid rain forms when SO₂ and NOₓ mix with water and oxygen in the air to make acidic pollutants. smog or ozone is a different idea, so those options are wrong. That matches the specific detail about Acid rain caused chemical reaction begins.

q: Because carbonic acid is a relatively weak acid, the ability of carbon dioxide alone to generate true acid rain is very _____.
e: Because carbonic acid is a relatively weak acid, the ability of carbon dioxide alone to generate true acid rain is very limited. Acid rain forms when SO₂ and NOₓ mix with water and oxygen in the air to make acidic pollutants. high or dangerous is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: Spilled oil can damage the ecosystem and its _____.
e: Spilled oil can damage the ecosystem and its habitats. Oil spills wreck living habitats in the ecosystem, not the stratosphere. atmosphere or stratosphere is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: Emissions from vehicles, thermal power plants and factories contain unburned hydrocarbons, particulates, carbon dioxide, carbon monoxide and oxides of nitrogen and sulphur that contribute to the lowering of the quality of _____.
e: The choice that completes this fact is air. water or soil is a different idea, so those options are wrong. That matches the specific detail about Emissions vehicles thermal power plants factories.

q: Any large-scale construction and drilling operation for geothermal development will produce visual impacts on the landscape, create noise and wastes and affect local _____.
e: Any large-scale construction and drilling operation for geothermal development will produce visual impacts on the landscape, create noise and wastes and affect local economy. Geothermal energy is heat from the Earth's interior, used to drive turbines. climate or ozone is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: There are global warming emissions associated with growing and harvesting biomass feedstock, transporting feedstock to the power plant, and burning or _____ the feedstock.
e: There are global warming emissions associated with growing and harvesting biomass feedstock, transporting feedstock to the power plant, and burning or gasifying the feedstock. Biomass is renewable organic material from plants and animals. freezing or liquefying is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: The problems posed by acid rains include corrosion of the built environment, soil degradation, water pollution and depletion of _____.
e: The problems posed by acid rains include corrosion of the built environment, soil degradation, water pollution and depletion of forests. Acid rain forms when SO₂ and NOₓ mix with water and oxygen in the air to make acidic pollutants. minerals or ozone is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: Renewable energy sources (non-conventional) do not pollute the environment and natural surrounding and require less _____.
e: Renewable energy sources (non-conventional) do not pollute the environment and natural surrounding and require less expenditure. Renewable, or non-conventional, sources are replenished by natural processes on a human time scale. time or space is a different idea, so those options are wrong.
